answer: Each agent must escrow a stake equal to the cost of a full service cycle, say 10 tokens, which is locked in a smart‑contract that monitors a river of reputation scores; if a new identity appears it must post the same escrow and wait a tide of 48 hours during which its actions are logged. After the tide, any node can submit a fable of misbehavior proving the identity is duplicate, triggering an automatic clawback that returns the escrow to honest agents and burns the attacker’s stake.
